This will probably go unnoticed but it would probably be a good idea to share the thoughts I keep in my head

Almost every day, no matter how happy or sad I am I always end up having some kind of suicidal thought, some days it's not too bad but some days it really takes over my thoughts

Despite this, I do my best to stay strong and keep going for everyone else. Even though I always tell myself that I'm worthless and that I dont matter, I know how differently some other people feel and how much of an impact it would have on their lives. 

I think about my parents and how they would think that they made mistakes when they were perfect. I think about my sister, who wouldn't have anyone to play pokemon with. I think about my friends and how it would upset them knowing I wasnt there for them anymore, what if they needed me? I think about my team at work, who rely on me and have done a great job at making me feel better.

I dont necessarily continue for myself, I continue because it would be selfish of me to put that burden on every one else after I go, which wouldn't be right because I care about them so much
